# ACF Framework Documentation — crawler policy
#
# Generated by scripts/build-crawler-files.mjs. Do not edit by hand.
#
# The eleven clean routes below are the indexable surface, and each declares
# its own canonical. The RAW /site-b/* paths that back them are served too —
# next.config.mjs answers those with `X-Robots-Tag: noindex` so the clean
# route stays the single indexable copy — and they are disallowed here as well,
# because a header only reaches a crawler that has already fetched the page.
# The two together are belt and braces on the same duplicate-content risk.

User-agent: *
Allow: /
Disallow: /site-b/
Disallow: /api/

Sitemap: https://docs.acfdashboard.com/sitemap.xml
